method: built-precedent research, reference-locked multi-view ImageGen design-source pack, clean six-zone material plate, occupied pool-depth source, and deterministic metric Blender geometry
binding_identity: A transparent civic natatorium is unified by one continuous asymmetrical double-wave silver shell, two cable-stay masts, pale diagonal concrete branch supports and warm timber pool-hall depth, with the competition crest visibly larger than the leisure crest.

design_lock.identity: A transparent civic natatorium unified by one continuous asymmetrical double-wave silver shell, two cable-stay masts, pale diagonal concrete branch supports, and warm timber pool-hall depth.
non_negotiable_features: The competition-pool crest is visibly larger and taller than the leisure-pool crest.
The two roof crests form one continuous shell with a deep glazed saddle valley.
Exactly two slender cable-stay masts and credible tension rods reinforce the long-span roof.
Pale board-formed diagonal concrete branch supports are integrated with the glazed facade.
The front is full-height low-iron pool glazing with visible lap-pool and timber-structure depth.
The recessed double-height public entrance sits at the valley/right-third position.
The service elevation combines translucent ribbed polycarbonate, a dark plinth, and restrained cobalt panels.

lego_contract.delivery: fixed-landmark assembled GLB plus a podium/floor/crown/roof fallback kit
lego_contract.sizing_intent: Hand-drawn rectangles inside the scale band preserve one continuous roof; oversized sites use streetwall repeat rather than family_incompatible.

assets.prompt: Create an original premium photoreal architectural reference of an 80 m by 55 m, one-tall-storey, 14 m crest parametric wave-shell aquatic centre. Use a restrained front three-quarter view. One continuous asymmetrical double-wave silver and polycarbonate roof forms a larger competition-pool crest, a glazed valley and a smaller leisure-pool crest. Integrate six pale board-formed concrete diagonal branch supports, exactly two cable-stay masts with realistic tension rods, full-height low-iron pool glazing with warm timber baffles, visible lap-pool and diving-platform depth, a real recessed double-height entrance at the right third, a dark plinth, restrained cobalt fritted wet-service panels, a translucent side wall, and a bioswale forecourt. True material response and buildable details. No text, cartoon rendering, fantasy structure, generic rectangular roof, or facade-blocking context.

Using the canonical image as the exact same architectural design, create a photoreal orthographic-style front elevation. Preserve the 80 m building, asymmetrical continuous double-wave roof, large competition crest, saddle valley, smaller leisure crest, pale diagonal branch supports, two cable masts, full-height pool glazing with warm timber baffles and occupied pool depth, the recessed right-third entrance, dark plinth, cobalt panels and bioswale forecourt. Centered level camera, neutral overcast daylight, no labels, text, logos, fantasy curves, generic roof or perspective exaggeration.
